title: Clean Water for All Communities
description: Help us build boreholes and water wells in communities lacking access to clean water. Each borehole serves an average of 500 people and lasts 15+ years with proper maintenance. Currently, millions of Nigerians lack access to safe drinking water, leading to waterborne diseases and lost productivity. Your donation will directly fund the construction of water infrastructure in the most needy communities.
shortDescription: Building boreholes and wells for communities without clean water access.

title: Feed the Fasting: Ramadan Food Program
description: Provide food packages to families in need during Ramadan. Each package feeds a family of 5 for the entire month and costs ₦25,000. This program distributes rice, beans, cooking oil, dates, and other essentials to families who cannot afford adequate meals for Suhoor and Iftar.
shortDescription: Providing food packages to families during Ramadan.

title: Orphans Education Support Program
description: Sponsor the education of orphaned children. Your donation covers school fees, uniforms, books, and daily meals. Currently supporting 50 orphans across primary and secondary levels. For ₦50,000 per term, you can sponsor a child's complete education.

title: Emergency Medical Aid Fund
description: Provide emergency medical assistance to those who cannot afford critical healthcare. Covers surgeries, treatments, and medications. This fund responds to urgent cases referred by hospitals and community health workers.
shortDescription: Emergency medical assistance for those in critical need.

title: Women's Skills Training Program
description: Empower women with vocational skills including tailoring, catering, and computer literacy. Each training cycle runs for 6 months and graduates 100 women with skills to start their own businesses. Includes starter kits upon graduation.
shortDescription: Vocational training for women to achieve financial independence.

title: Shelter for Displaced Families
description: Provide temporary housing and essential supplies for families displaced by conflict or natural disasters. Each shelter unit costs ₦150,000 and houses a family for up to 6 months.
